senses.gloss: m., pl. פִּיקּוּסִין, פִּיקּוּסַיָּא (v. פָּקַס II) removing the coils on the blossom end of gourds.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 88b:5">B. Mets. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דגמר לפִיקּוּסַיְּהוּ</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) until he has finished the entire work of removing &c.; <he>מדמתחלן פיקוסייהו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מכי אתחולי</he>) when the removing work has been started.
